items.title: Hank Cicalo interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 30, 2022
items.q: The A bands in New York for a long time was Richard Tee, Steve Gadd on drums, Ralph McDonald percussion, I mean Hugh McCracken on guitar, Eric Gale on guitar. Those were the A guys.

ctx.x: Who did you like to see especially coming on a date as far as the rhythm section players? Did you have favorite drummers?

Oh, oh yea. You have favorite drummers, you have favorite bass players. And strangely — well not strangely enough — I mean the guys that work together, for example like in New York I always — the New York players, I loved the way New York players play, what Steve Gadd played with Richard Tee, and always those New York guys had a different feel. Because they worked together so often and they knew how each — you know. In L.A. it was different because you’d have — like in New York what I’m talking about was it was…
